purpose: Research-only handoff for nums 553, 554, 555, 556, 558, 559, 560, 562, 563, 564, 565, 566, 567, 568, 569, 570, 571, 572, 573, and 574 in data-nickelodeon.js. Built from live Common Sense Media refetches of catalog srcUrl pages. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This refetch preserves CSM's current visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Where CSM's label and category detail conflict, the proposed level may reflect the detail rather than the label and a handoff note is included.

entries.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie

violence.summary: Cartoon peril escalates from shoving and smacking to knife-fight imagery, dagger-like boots, ruthless bullies, and repeated punching threats.

language.summary: Language is mostly mild name-calling, one wordplay insult, and a phrase using damn as an adjective.

romance.summary: Characters appear in underwear, body parts become gag material, a female character is ogled, and Patrick wears stripper-style boots.

drinking.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick mimic drunken behavior after an ice-cream binge, while a bar scene includes alcohol, cigarettes, real drunkenness, and brawling.

handoffNotes: Drunken behavior is partly spoofed through ice cream but also appears in a real bar setting.

entries.title: Barnyard

violence.summary: Coyotes threaten the farm animals and kill Otis' father; there are also cow-tipping and boy-tipping gags.

language.summary: CSM's detail text notes milk-based phrases used as fake profanity.

romance.summary: CSM's detail text mentions Otis' interest in a pregnant cow and odd udder-based body humor.

drinking.summary: Milk is repeatedly coded like alcohol for the animals, including drinking in cars and outside a window; the farmer also drinks.

handoffNotes: CSM labels Language and Sex, Romance & Nudity as none while detail text mentions fake profanity and body/romance jokes.
Otis' father's death may need emotional prose for younger viewers.

entries.title: Firehouse Dog

violence.summary: Firefighter-death flashbacks, intense fire scenes, and a boy trapped in a burning house with an arsonist may frighten younger viewers.

language.summary: Mild PG-level insults and curses appear.

romance.summary: CSM's detail text notes flirting among adults, kids, and dogs, hand-holding, hugs, and colleagues staring at a firefighter in a sexy gown.

drinking.summary: A benefit gala briefly shows champagne drinking.

handoffNotes: CSM labels Sex, Romance & Nudity as none while detail text mentions flirting, hand-holding, and a sexy gown.
Fire death and arson peril may need prose context.

entries.title: The Last Airbender

violence.summary: Elemental and martial-arts fights are mostly non-graphic, though fire, water, and rocks are used in combat and one self-sacrificial death occurs.

language.summary: CSM's detail text mentions mild insult language about Fire Nation and other peoples.

romance.summary: There is one sweet kiss, mild flirting, and a line encouraging a nephew to think about pretty girls.

drinking.summary: A commander makes a luncheon toast, though CSM says actual drinking is unclear.

handoffNotes: CSM labels Language as none while detail text mentions mild insults.
The self-sacrificial death may need prose despite gentle handling.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

violence.summary: North Pole peril includes ravine and snowy-mountain falls, a penguin repeatedly slapping an elf, and a gingerbread-man bite/revenge gag.

romance.summary: Timmy and Tootie share one kiss.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

entries.title: Fun Size

violence.summary: Teen-comedy peril includes an MMA fighter threatening people, kidnapping and confining a boy, bully provocation, a comic weapon duel, fireworks retaliation, an apartment fire, and a character being pummeled.

language.summary: Language includes moderate profanity, crude body terms, insults, religious exclamations, and a crude hair-removal joke.

romance.summary: Sexual material includes passionate teen and party kissing, implied teen hooking up or sharing a bed, a younger boyfriend spending the night with a single mother, and kissing in front of her kids.

drinking.summary: Partygoers drink and smoke, underage teens drink at a high-school party, and drinking and driving is noted.

handoffNotes: Underage drinking, drinking and driving, teen sexual implications, and child kidnapping need prose context.
